== Biography ==
Jane Murray married William Lauder in the First Presbyterian Church, Albany, New York, on 30th January 1787.<ref>Marriage: https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:F634-N7M?lang=en</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Possible Jane Murray of Omagh ===
A marriage notice published on 5 September 1786 names Jane Murray of Omagh, aged sixteen, as bride of James Glasco, an Omagh publican aged sixty-one.<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/1050075355/ The Public Register, or, Freeman's Journal, 1786-09-05, p.3].</ref>

Her reported age suggests birth about 1769–1770. The notice names no parents and gives no exact marriage day or subsequent history. A later marriage to a different husband is not by itself proof that she was a different woman.

This may concern [[Murray-34126]]. The approximate 1770 birth is compatible with Jane’s reported age. Her recorded marriage to [[Lauder-1416|William Lauder]] does not establish an Omagh or Glasco connection; a remarriage remains possible. The Albany marriage on 30 January 1787 would require a rapid change of household and country after the September 1786 Omagh notice.
